# idsec_cmgr_connector (Data Source)

The Connector Management service connector data source. It reads the connector information and metadata based on the connector ID.
<!-- BEGIN CUSTOM NOTES -->
<!-- END CUSTOM NOTES -->

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connector_id` (String) The ID of the connector to get.

### Read-Only

- `connector_pool_id` (String) The connector pool ID.
- `connector_status` (String) The status of the connector.
- `installed_at` (Number) The installation time of the connector (epoch timestamp).
- `platform_type` (String) The host platform type.
- `updated_at` (Number) The last update time of the connector (epoch timestamp).
- `upgrade_versions` (List of String) Available upgrade versions.
- `version` (String) The version of the connector.
